{{Top|leg}}
'''Prydde''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In a comment on the Datalog entry for the [[Amplified Synth-Harmonica]], Prydde informed other subscribers that the [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]] was paying good money for shipments of musical instruments for their [[Studies in Contemporary Non-Human Music and Dance]] program.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
